headline: How to Build $4,000 a Month in Dividend Income Without Selling a Single Share
summary: Generating $48,000 a year in dividends sounds like a retirement fantasy until you see how the math actually splits across three very different yield strategies, each demanding a radically different amount of starting capital and carrying its own hidden cost.
